gold_review.explanation: Each prompt is multimodal: a text part plus eight image_url parts. Our mock's first_user_text crashed joining the content parts (`p.get('text','')` returns None for image parts), so every request errored and no gold reply was ever sent (gold_hits=0). The grader itself is a plain last-word match (genuine/upsampled) against `answer` and would accept the raw answer.
